logins_per_seat_trend_3m.transform: pct change in (login sum / avg active seats) over a 30d window vs the same window 90d earlier

searches_per_seat_trend_3m.transform: pct change in (search sum / avg active seats), recent 30d vs 30d window 90d earlier

inmail_sends_trend_3m.transform: pct change in (inmail_send sum / avg active seats), recent 30d vs 30d window 90d earlier

pct_seats_active_30d.transform: avg active seats over trailing 30d / seats_contracted

crm_sync_active_30d.transform: most recent crm_sync_status value in trailing 30d (null if no event)

avg_session_duration_trend.transform: pct change in avg session_duration_min, recent 30d vs 30d window 90d earlier

support_tickets_90d.transform: count of support_ticket events in trailing 90d

champion_turnover_flag.transform: 1 if any champion_turnover event in trailing 180d, else 0

seat_utilization_vs_contracted.transform: most recent active seat count as of as_of_date / seats_contracted

nps_last_survey.transform: most recent nps_survey value in trailing 180d (null if none)
